bends.note: north side of 3rd turns ENE at about x=3090; centreline bends from E to ENE (about 25 deg) between Broadway and Ludlow, south side stays straight to Ludlow so the street widens into a wedge

notes: Sheet covers Sycamore-Broadway (4th-3rd) and Broadway-Ludlow (4th-Pearl). Broadway printed 100' south of 4th; north of 4th (sheet 123) it is narrower and the east side jogs, so Broadway/4th is the middle of the four corners. Irwin Alley (printed IRWIN ALLEY, 10') runs from 4th to Arch. Arch (printed ARCH, 32') runs Broadway to Ludlow; east of Ludlow a narrow street (~19 ft, name not printed here, block on sheet 124) continues ENE from the same point, so Arch/Ludlow is recorded as a cross. E 4th bends to ENE at Ludlow/Lawrence: Ludlow (33') ends at 4th (T); Lawrence St has a narrow N-S leg north of 4th (centre x~3551) and a 60' leg running SSE from 4th, offset ~55 px from each other, so the Lawrence/4th point is the mean of the two leg-centreline crossings (uncertain by ~30 px). E 3rd, E Pearl and E 4th all turn ENE at or just west of Ludlow. Ludlow/3rd point is where the bent 3rd centreline crosses Ludlow; the SW corner (south side of 3rd) lies far south at y~2605. West of Broadway Pearl is split into two roadways around a narrow block (old market space): 'N.E. PEARL ST.' (centre y~3158, T at Broadway) and 'S.E. PEARL ST.' (centre y~3489), which meets Broadway opposite E. PEARL (centre y~3541) with a ~50 px jog; the Broadway/E Pearl point is the middle of the four corners. Ludlow widens south of Pearl (about 63 ft). Alley entry: unnamed ~9 ft gap between block outlines east of Ludlow at y~2627 (blocks belong to sheet 124). The E. Bourne Terrace stub on sheet 117 (east side of Sycamore at y~1527 in this sheet's frame) is not drawn here: the frontage is covered by a 1928 garage, only a 4in pipe stub remains.
